title: Holiday Inn Goa Candolim
description:
Welcome to Holiday Inn Resort, your Mediterranean-inspired retreat located at Mobor Beach, Cavelossim, in South Goa. Enjoy direct access to the enchanting Arabian Sea, offering a unique and unforgettable experience.

Conveniently located 38km from Dabolim International Airport and 17km from Margao Railway Station, our resort provides an ideal setting for a relaxing and fun-filled vacation in Goa. Our spacious rooms, each with a balcony, offer breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea and beautifully landscaped gardens.

Holiday Inn Resort features versatile indoor and outdoor venues perfect for meetings, events, and destination weddings. Our Ballroom, one of Goa’s largest pillar-less banquet halls at 5,068 sq ft, along with 1,26,000 sq ft of flexible lawn space, creates the perfect backdrop for romantic weddings.

title: Holiday Inn Resort Goa
description: Perched atop the verdant hills of Sinquerim, Holiday Inn Goa Candolim stands as a pinnacle of five-star accommodation in the vibrant heart of North Goa. Set against the backdrop of lush green landscapes, our hotel is a sanctuary of tranquility amidst the lively energy of the bustling street. As you step into the fully air-conditioned embrace of our rooms, a haven of comfort and sophistication awaits. The soundproof design ensures a peaceful night's sleep, allowing you to escape into dreams while surrounded by the natural beauty that defines Goa. Each room is thoughtfully appointed with modern conveniences, including a smart TV for entertainment, tea and coffee facilities to cater to your cravings. For those blending work with leisure, a dedicated work area with a desk awaits, offering a serene space to focus and create. Multiple device connection options ensure seamless productivity, making it an ideal retreat for business travelers seeking both efficiency and relaxation. Amidst the embrace of nature, embark on a culinary journey curated by our expert chefs. The Viva Lounge and Bar, our all-day dining restaurant, is a haven for gastronomic delights. Indulge in a delectable spread that captures the essence of Goa's diverse flavors, elevating your dining experience to new heights. For connoisseurs of crafted libations, the Atrium Bar beckons.

title: Holiday Inn Genoa City
description: Experience comfort and elegance at Holiday Inn Goa, where modern luxury meets the serene charm of coastal living. Nestled close to pristine beaches, the hotel offers beautifully designed rooms, exceptional dining options, and world-class amenities for both leisure and business travelers. Relax by the sparkling pool, rejuvenate at the fitness center, or indulge in delicious local and international cuisine. Whether you're planning a family vacation or a romantic getaway, Holiday Inn Goa promises a memorable and refreshing stay.

title: Crowne Plaza
description: Welcome to Crowne Plaza Today Gurugram, a premier business hotel located in the heart of central business district. Located near leading MNCs like Google, McKinsey, PwC, and Accenture, the hotel blends a combination of business and leisure with the comfort of luxury.

title: Holiday Inn Express
description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express, your ideal destination for a modern and hassle-free. Located within the Good Earth City Centre Mall, the hotel provides easy access to a variety of retail and dining options, as well as popular spots like Bani Square.
